title: OpenSpec UI Agentic Harness — global config
description: Global default for openspec/agent-harness.json — see the agentic-harness capability. At this level: reviewGate.mode is fixed to human-required, autonomyLevel excludes autonomous, and checkpoints.requireConfirmationBetweenSteps is fixed to true. Only a per-change openspec/changes/<id>/harness.json may relax any of these.

autonomyLevel.description: autonomous is only valid in a per-change harness.json, never here — see openspec/changes/agentic-harness-autonomy/design.md.

mode.description: agent-sufficient is only valid in a per-change harness.json, never here.

requireConfirmationBetweenSteps.description: false is only valid in a per-change harness.json, never here — see openspec/changes/agentic-harness-autonomy/design.md.

agentId.description: Must match an AgentDescriptor.id from packages/core/src/agents/registry.ts — kept in sync by hand (a small, stable list).
